rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Walk-away test (M2+).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Claude independently reads two recorded sessions and later scans cross-project history; expanded lines 83–85 let the engineer detach, interrupt, narrow, or stop rather than consuming every progress reply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: 50% magic rule (M3–M8).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Training-level distribution rule, not decidable from one exercise file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust the agentic design — no human backstops.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The agent reads transcripts, repo state, and project history. Human work is high-value ranking, skepticism, stopping, and routing rather than exhaustive manual verification.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Quality ladder.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The fresh three-persona story trace places both teaching phases and the close at the 8/10 ship bar. The gap map and stack shapes are re-runnable feedstock for M6's closing encode move; the full module, not this exercise alone, owns the leverage peak.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: One exercise = one bounded activity.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The bounded activity is reading the system's evidence to route one dominant gap: two-session diagnosis produces the gap, the wider scan locates it in recurring work, and the primitives comparison makes the final route actionable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Modules composable across variants.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The shared exercise carries no variant fork; all AE101-specific continuity is expressed through the common M4/M5 artefacts and prompt registry.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Three-level completeness.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The M6 testing-and-learning frame leads to runtime gap and stack maps; those shapes are explicitly consumed by the closing handoff prompt, which is the durable encode move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pattern-recognition LOs need n≥2 instances with contrast.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phase 1 contrasts two sessions of the same task with paired quoted moments; Phase 2 then samples recurring work across multiple projects and instances.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Progression-with-variations is the spine.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M6 repeats review-and-compound under a new face: compare two long sessions, subtract a stale rule, then generalize the learning across the stack. It is not M5's packaging move repeated verbatim.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency — adults decide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Expanded line 78 assigns scan width and map choice to the engineer. Lines 83–85 offer a fast path and a human stop gate keyed to usefulness, without forcing either pace.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Delegation — student brings, Claude screens.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Claude has local access to task.md, plan.md, git refs, transcripts, CLAUDE.local.md, and ~/.claude/projects. It pattern-matches and drafts while the engineer chooses damage, scope, and destination.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Split mega-exercise when phases = distinct skills + distinct artifacts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Re-derived at phase grain: there is no natural handoff between phases. Phase 1's dominant gap is consumed by Phase 2's primitives ranking, and the final routing requires both the gap evidence and recurring shapes in the same warm session. Splitting would add an artificial scrollback/artifact boundary before the route is complete.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-realism check.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The M5 worktree, task.md and plan.md coordinates, m4/m5 refs, transcript paths, CLAUDE.local.md, and Claude project history are all established local AE101 artefacts rather than invented dependencies.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Teach principle + technique — default.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise explains why paired evidence, rule subtraction, drawn work-shapes, and gap routing matter, then supplies the exact prompts and decision boundaries to perform each move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Auto-fire sim+eval after significant rewrite.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The current source SHA has a freshly regenerated three-persona story trace and this complete pedagogy re-fire; both stale phase slices were re-evaluated rather than inherited.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go. Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Expanded fences carry the quoted diff, rank, one-rule cut, history scan, diagrams, and primitives fit. Lines 83–85 are optional path and attention governors covered by §16's pacing-calibration boundary; they do not replace a load-bearing prompt or prescribe a reaction.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Corporate infra = nice-to-have, never forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The learning works from the student's local repo, personal rules, and local Claude history. Sponsor or team conventions appear only as optional plug points.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Personal-first, team promotion via human conversation.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The only immediate mutation is a personal ./CLAUDE.local.md rule cut. Skill candidates remain names for later authoring; no agent auto-promotes shared infrastructure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Measure silent failure, not just friction.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Cohort-observation methodology, not a static exercise-body requirement.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't pre-set categories before experiment runs.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The two M4/M5 experiments already ran before the diagnostic lenses are applied. Phase 2 asks recurring-work categories to emerge from actual history rather than supplying a taxonomy in advance.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verification layers sample different error distributions.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise explicitly separates transcript evidence, repo-state evidence, rules-file behavior, verifier blind spots, and cross-project recurrence; no one layer is treated as proof for all failure shapes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cheap-before-expensive verification ordering.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The focused two-session diff and dominant-gap rank happen before the expensive cross-project scan. The stop gate prevents continued scan spend after the useful patterns are already clear.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rule in memory without forcing function = worse than no rule.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No new maintainer memory rule is authored by this exercise; the student removes one evidence-killed rule.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Short skeptical pushback on done = re-verify trigger.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Expanded lines 49–50 give concrete skeptical re-checks for generalized evidence and verifier over-credit before the gap map closes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cohort execution is trainer-paced + concurrent, not sequential.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The body supports concurrent follow-along and explicitly lets fast operators keep the three Phase 2 prompts in one warm conversation. The one genuinely long scan is bounded by the human stop gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Host-skill optional; maintainer blocks trainer-only.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer diagnostics name trainer pushes and observable student states; no Agentic Nerd or other host skill is a cohort prerequisite.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats: in-chat over file-write.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Gap maps, primitive menu, diagrams, and routing stay in chat. The sole file edit changes CLAUDE.local.md because future sessions auto-read it.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The expanded body contains no authored pair, group-share, room-discussion, or trainer pause cue. All instructions concern the engineer's evidence, agent, files, and decisions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Eval = fixed yardstick; thing measured learns.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise diagnoses an existing verifier and maps checking primitives; it does not run a repeated scoring loop whose yardstick could move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reading burden for verification = banned. Claude audits Claude.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Claude performs the transcript, git, and cross-project reads. The engineer reads ranked evidence to learn and decide, with explicit permission to stop at two or three useful patterns; the file never assigns exhaustive manual correctness checking.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Self-report + self-audit charity.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The diff prompt requires quoted artifact moments and repo-state checks, while expanded line 50 explicitly counters packaging over-credit with a concrete missed-verifier challenge.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Offered structures need forced-engagement mechanic.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The three gap homes are not a template to accept: the final Evaluate beat requires the engineer to commit the dominant gap to one home, backed by the earlier evidence and shapes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Source-type blindness on ingestion.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No heterogeneous slide or document ingestion occurs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Task selection drives outcome — name floor AND ceiling.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise reuses an already selected same-task pair and does not ask the student to choose a new execution task.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer-block hedge naming section's own failure mode = cut-signal.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The maintainer's scan-sprawl and mood watch-fors correspond to live body recovery gates; no hedge is propping up an otherwise indefensible premise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audience tier determines authoring substrate.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Worktrees, git refs, transcript paths, local rules, and mermaid diagrams match AE101's engineer substrate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verification machinery needs smoke-test before trust.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This exercise diagnoses an already smoke-tested M5 verifier and maps future checking primitives; it builds no new verification machinery.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Context-loading tiers as staged progression.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise uses explicit transcript and history reads but does not teach the three context-loading tiers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Removals are strategic — ask before cutting.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Generation-time rule about removing curriculum entities. The student's evidence-gated deletion of one personal rule is the exercise's subject, not a curriculum edit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Symmetric visible mechanics over runtime fork.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 is Claude Code-only; there is no dual-runtime fork.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Load-bearing platform feature = no fallback.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The existing M5 worktree and local transcript surfaces are treated as required architecture, not diluted with a pretend-equivalent platform fallback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Eval architecture — partition by evidence source.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Curriculum-evaluation infrastructure rule, not the exercise's student-facing architecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Plug points + UX.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Plug points name the M4/M5 artefacts, repo skill-home convention, and team review conventions, each tied to a downstream phase. Prompt chaining is warm-session and artifact-backed, and the scan has visible fast and recovery paths.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-exercise leap test — 3 observable Monday outcomes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Raw lines 152–155 name three own-codebase outcomes: use a diagrammed work map, cut an evidence-killed CLAUDE.local.md rule, and route a surfaced gap to memory, verifier, or skill.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-phase failure mode + escape hatch.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer lines 210–214 cover both forcing-function phases at the phase unit: Phase 1 has generalized-diff and packaging-over-credit diagnostics with quote recoveries; Phase 2 has scan-sprawl and gap-home-dodge diagnostics with the two-or-three-pattern stop gate, ranked-head recovery, and one-sentence routing check. The inline one-rule diff cap adds a second Phase 1 escape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heavy fan-out prompts get body recovery callout.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Expanded lines 83–85 name the heavy cross-project scan, give over-reading recovery (narrow it or request current findings), and set an evidence-quality stop condition: two or three recurring kinds clear enough to draw and compare. §48's premature-stop harm is absent once that downstream-sufficient threshold is met; restoring a generic keep-going nudge would recreate the overload the reading contract exists to remove.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Save belongs with authoring, not loading.
rules_evaluated.evidence: When the exercise authors a change, the one-rule deletion lands immediately in the production CLAUDE.local.md that future sessions load. Chat-only maps remain in chat for their immediate closing consumer.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Convenience-driven prompts with known shape-bias get acknowledgment.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The same-session diagnostic's self-charity risk is explicitly named at expanded line 50 with a harsher missed-verifier pushback; the broad scan's convenience risk is handled by the adjacent human stop gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Deliberate-antipattern prompts = class-judge exempt.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The deliberate un-packaged baseline was authored in M4; this file reads it as evidence and does not add a new antipattern prompt.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session widget shape and placement.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Expanded line 5 uses the canonical exercise-top Session widget to start the named M6 worktree session.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Widgets carry semantics, not just emphasis.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The Session widget starts a real new session; the scan and display affordances use ordinary blockquotes rather than misusing Session or HOX for prominence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pre-action framing doesn't preview prompt payoff.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Expanded lines 9–13 name activity, artifacts, and arc position. Phase lead-ins name what to do and build without announcing which gaps or recurring shapes the prompts will discover.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Engineer-audience audit fixes default to body callout.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The recoverable cognitive-load risk is handled by a nearby body stop gate rather than more prompt machinery. Quote and diff-spread recoveries are likewise lightweight body pushbacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Multi-session ships as packaging, not new primitive.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The Session widget explicitly reuses the existing M5 worktree with no fork. Session mechanics package the exercise but are not retaught as a new primitive.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: /clear = tool, not ceremony.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No /clear or context-wipe beat appears.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inbound links preserve pedagogical beat.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reference-page restructure is being evaluated in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Scan at the unit the rule names.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Audit-methodology rule applied here by judging coherence and failure recovery at phase grain and prerequisite rescue at receiving-module grain.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verify mechanism before proposing surgery.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No framework, skill, or platform surgery is proposed by this read-only evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Acting on a flagged item — verify before fixing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The old §64 and §65 findings were treated as hypotheses: the current plug point now points to training-architecture.md, and §65 places rescue at the receiving module's Start here, where current module lines 28–30 carry it. Neither stale prescription was inherited.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Callouts next to prompts: steer, don't pre-empt.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The scan callout teaches a reusable control move—narrow, request current findings, stop at useful evidence—rather than warning about a single brittle output shape. The quote and over-credit pushbacks are likewise actionable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Persistent TODO surfaces stale by default.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The file only points to pre-cohort-todos.md; this evaluation does not act on a persistent TODO item.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer blocks point, don't restate.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The current skill-home plug point at expanded line 218 uses a one-line pointer to training-architecture.md § Skills instead of restating install or promotion mechanics. Other maintainer material is file-specific evidence, diagnostics, and source provenance.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cross-module prerequisite rescue: run it late, never fabricate.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This rule places M5→M6 rescue at the receiving module's Start here, not inside the exercise. The current M6 module carries thin/stalled and accept-loss callouts there; duplicating them here would violate the named unit and add cognitive load.
